name: Cheese Straws (Variation 2)
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Sift into a bowl 1 cup flour, 1 saltspoon each of salt, paprika and baking powder
Add ¾ cup of butter and chop the ingredients together until of the consistency of meal
Mix to a paste with ice-water (use as little as possible)
Turn on to the pastry board and roll into a sheet about a quarter of an inch thick
Cut with a sharp knife into narrow strips about six inches long
Arrange cob-house fashion on a doiley-covered plate

source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift into a bowl 1 cup flour, 1 saltspoon each of salt, paprika and baking powder
2. Add 1 cup grated cheese
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Add ¾ cup of butter and chop the ingredients together until of the consistency of meal
5. Mix to a paste with ice-water (use as little as possible)
6. Turn on to the pastry board and roll into a sheet about a quarter of an inch thick
7. Cut with a sharp knife into narrow strips about six inches long
8. Bake to a pale yellow
9. Arrange cob-house fashion on a doiley-covered plate
